abstract.text: Keeps each video and input path’s health, chooses the live pair, and decides when a backup runs.
Where the picture comes from.
Follows Bluetooth, the helper link, the battery, the ledger’s minute, and whether the app is
in front, for the app’s life.
Takes what the helper said about itself and its Mac.
Dials every wanted transport now, whatever failed before: a helper was just paired, or the person chose Try again.
Whether a connected link’s stream drew nothing the last time it was asked, with no stream on screen.
The effects of dial steps.
What the helper last said about itself.
Tells the card to run or go back to standby when what the screen needs of it changed.
Records the path the router delivers input to now: the switch is done, and the path has its sink.
Records which Mac the connected helper is on and whether the capture display is on it.
A dial returned; one that left its link idle counts as failed for the dialling.
Every path’s health, and what the Smart gate needs from their recent past.
Which helper links to dial, and which failed ones wait for something to change first.
Takes the picture off the screen once its path has gone and nothing able to draw is about
to replace it, so the screen says why rather than holding a frozen frame, and the rest of
the app stops counting a picture that isn’t there.
Where input goes.
Chooses the video and input paths from their health and the person’s choices.
How the app’s reducers fit together, and how a touch or a key press reaches the Mac without passing through them.
What the capture card has been told to do: run, or wait in standby, configured and stopped.

Keeps the battery and Low Power Mode, logging a change of either that matters.
Publishes the live status, when it changed: the one exit every action leaves through
), so the status is always a function of this state.
The steady time every hold, wait and health age is judged on, so a clock change moves none.
Gives up a switch whose path drew nothing in time: the path is held, and the old path is
kept if it still works, else the choice is made again without the new one.
The network a helper link runs over.
Types through the layout of the Mac Bluetooth types to, as
finds it, else the one picked in Settings, else the one matching this device’s language,
and presses its shortcuts.
Remembers the route the connected Mac is on screen over, when it changed.
Puts a path that is no longer shown back to standby, or to the backup rate while it backs up the shown path.
Draws the shown stream again, after a switch away from it was given up on.
Pairs the helper link over the Bluetooth bond, once the person allows it.
Hands input to the new path’s sink; the router releases the old one first and replays what arrived meanwhile.
Dials the failed links a cue may have made reachable, at once.
Pairs the Mac with this device over Bluetooth through Headwire Helper, which answers the Mac’s side.
Starts the new video path and waits for its first frame, keeping the old layer on screen.
Judges a helper link against its transport’s limits: the one health policy for the link.
Takes the helper links’ new session phases: the dialling, the roster and each link’s health follow them.
Why no helper link is up: a link that ended for a reason the person can act on, the best
transport’s first; else what the network link’s ending says about the network, a Mac
listed that didn’t answer before one not listed at all.
Records the card’s path, and treats a card or accessory turning up, or the card going, as
a cue: a card plugged in may be a USB accessory the Mac is reached through, and a card
unplugged leaves the helper as the only way to the Mac’s picture.
Decides which Bluetooth host gets this device’s keyboard and pointer, for the app’s life.
What Bluetooth types and gestures through for the computers using this device as their
keyboard: the first one a paired Mac’s helper names, by what that Mac’s helper said; else,
for a computer no helper names, the layout picked for it here, with nothing reported, so a
Mac without the helper doesn’t type through another Mac’s layout; else the last reporting
Mac’s.
Battery samples taken each minute, split by whether a backup stream was running, to measure what Instant switch costs.
The live pair, and what Automatic remembers about paths it moved off.
Keeps each video and input path’s health, chooses the live pair, and decides when a backup runs.
Remembers what a helper said about its Mac’s keyboard and trackpad, and hands the keyboard to the Bluetooth path.
Follows the cues for the links that may need one, and keeps the fixed retry pending while
the screen says the Mac can’t be reached.

The iPad and iPhone app: one screen that shows the Mac’s picture and sends the Mac input from touch, trackpad, mouse, Pencil, and keyboard.
What the connectivity feature tells the rest of the app: the live pair, how each is doing, and the backup.
Stops a link’s video, or drops it back to the backup rate while it backs up the shown path.
Follows the helper link: each transport’s state and health, what the helper says, first
frames, and the paired Macs; which links to dial is
’s choice.
Keeps the computers using this device as their Bluetooth keyboard, and hands Bluetooth
another layout when they change whose it is.
Whether a switch to the path may begin now.
The one place a video switch’s end is logged, and its “Video switch” signpost ended, so
every switch the log begins it also ends, and no interval stays open under the exclusive
id to be paired with the next switch’s end.
Dials the links worth having and closes the rest, as
decides, and follows
the cues that bring a failed one back.
Acts on the choice of Mac.
How a video switch ended.
Makes the choice again, decides the backup, publishes the status, and schedules the next choice due by time.
Logs a link call that failed; the link’s health already shows the failure to the person.
Takes a link’s latest numbers and judges every link again.
Decides whether a low-rate backup stream runs beside the active video, and on which path.
Asks a link for video and draws it.
How often the battery is sampled and the backup gate looked at again.
The scene came to the foreground, which is a cue, or went to the background, which stops
every retry by time. An inactive scene, under an alert or Siri, is neither.
Adds this minute’s battery reading to the ledger, when the system reports a level.
The wall clock, for what is kept across launches: the battery ledger.
Records a path whose sink couldn’t be had: input goes nowhere, and the status shows the path as failing.
Pairs this device with Headwire Helper on a Mac: by the USB cable, by the code the Mac shows,
read from the capture card or typed, or by the QR code scanned with the Camera app.
Records Bluetooth’s path; any change in it is a cue, since the Mac’s Bluetooth coming back
is often the first sign it woke or restarted.
Shows the new layer, hides the old one, and puts the old path back to standby.
The transports a cue wakes.
Gives up a switch before its first frame: the path it started goes back to standby, and
the stream feed, which moved to that path when the switch began, goes back to the stream
on screen.
The health the choice is made from: the card counts as unavailable while it shows another Mac.
Lifts the hold on each of these transports’ streams that drew nothing, and forgets their
timeouts, when something says they may draw now: a new session on the link, the helper
saying something new about its stream, or the person choosing Try again.
Moves the router and the screen to the selection, input first.
How long after the keychain refuses this device’s key it is asked again for Bluetooth pairing.
